name: Deep Fried Sea Bass with Fish Sauce (Tray)
nameTh: ปลากะพงทอดน้ำปลา + ยำมะม่วงสด
desc: Whole deep-fried sea bass served in sweet aromatic fish sauce with a side of freshly shredded mango salad, roasted peanuts, and crispy fried shallots.
ingredients: Whole Sea Bass, Vegetable Oil (frying), Thai Fish Sauce, Palm Sugar, Fresh Shredded Mango, Roasted Peanuts, Crispy Fried Shallots, Bird's Eye Chili, Fresh Lime Juice, Coriander.

name: Pla Lui Suan - Crispy Sea Bass with Thai Herbs (Tray)
nameTh: ปลากะพงลุยสวนสมุนไพรสด
desc: Crispy whole sea bass topped with an aromatic medley of fresh Thai herbs, lemongrass, mint, ginger, and spicy tamarind dressing.
ingredients: Whole Sea Bass, Lemongrass, Kaffir Lime Leaves, Fresh Mint, Fresh Ginger, Shallots, Roasted Peanuts, Fresh Lime, Bird's Eye Chili, Fish Sauce, Tamarind Paste, Palm Sugar.

name: Choo Chee Fried Sea Bass (4000ml)
nameTh: ฉู่ฉี่ปลากะพงทอดกรอบ
desc: Crispy sea bass bathed in a rich, creamy red Choo Chee curry sauce with coconut cream and kaffir lime leaves. Large 4-litre tub.
ingredients: Whole Sea Bass, Choo Chee Red Curry Paste (Chili, Lemongrass, Garlic, Shallots, Galangal, Kaffir Lime, Shrimp Paste), Coconut Cream, Fish Sauce, Palm Sugar, Kaffir Lime Leaves, Sweet Basil, Red Chili.

name: Massaman Beef Curry (4000ml)
nameTh: แกงมัสมั่นเนื้อตุ๋นสูตรโบราณ (Halal)
desc: Slow-cooked tender Halal beef brisket in aromatic royal Massaman curry with soft potatoes, roasted peanuts, and whole spices. Large 4-litre tub.
ingredients: Halal Beef Chuck, Coconut Milk, Massaman Curry Paste (Cardamom, Cinnamon, Cloves, Star Anise, Lemongrass, Chili, Shallots), Potatoes, Roasted Peanuts, Onions, Tamarind, Palm Sugar, Fish Sauce.

name: Kor Moo Yang - Grilled Pork Neck (Tray)
nameTh: คอหมูย่างเตาถ่าน + น้ำจิ้มแจ่วข้าวคั่ว
desc: Tender pork neck marinated in garlic, pepper, and Thai seasoning, charcoal-grilled and sliced. Served with signature spicy toasted rice tamarind dip (Nam Jim Jaew).
ingredients: Pork Neck, Light Soy Sauce, Oyster Sauce, Seasoning Sauce, Garlic, Coriander Root, White Pepper, Palm Sugar. Dipping Sauce: Tamarind Paste, Lime Juice, Fish Sauce, Toasted Ground Rice Powder (Khao Khua), Chili Flakes, Shallots, Spring Onion.

name: Suea Rong Hai - Crying Tiger Beef (Tray)
nameTh: เสือร้องไห้เนื้อพรีเมียมย่างไฟ + น้ำจิ้มแจ่ว
desc: Premium Halal beef grilled over fire, juicy and flavorful, sliced and served with homemade spicy Isan tamarind dipping sauce.
ingredients: Halal Beef Brisket/Sirloin, Light Soy Sauce, Oyster Sauce, Garlic, Black Pepper, Coriander Root, Palm Sugar. Dipping Sauce: Tamarind Juice, Fish Sauce, Fresh Lime, Toasted Ground Rice, Crushed Dried Chili, Shallots, Spring Onion.

name: Panang Chicken Curry (4000ml)
nameTh: แกงพะแนงไก่กะทิข้น
desc: Tender chicken breast in rich and fragrant Panang curry paste with thick coconut cream, ground peanuts, and shredded kaffir lime leaves. Large 4-litre tub.
ingredients: Halal Chicken Breast, Coconut Cream, Panang Curry Paste (Chili, Galangal, Lemongrass, Kaffir Lime, Coriander Seed, Cumin, Shrimp Paste, Ground Peanuts), Fish Sauce, Palm Sugar, Kaffir Lime Leaves, Sweet Basil, Red Chili.

name: Red Duck Curry (4000ml)
nameTh: แกงเผ็ดเป็ดย่างสับปะรดองุ่น
desc: Succulent roasted duck breast in traditional red curry sauce with sweet pineapple, cherry tomatoes, and grapes. Large 4-litre tub.
ingredients: Roasted Duck Breast, Coconut Milk, Red Curry Paste (Chili, Lemongrass, Garlic, Shallots, Galangal, Shrimp Paste), Pineapple, Cherry Tomatoes, Grapes, Sweet Basil, Kaffir Lime Leaves, Fish Sauce, Palm Sugar.

name: Green Chicken Curry (4000ml)
nameTh: แกงเขียวหวานไก่มะเขือเปราะ
desc: Classic Thai green curry with chicken breast, authentic round aubergines, pea aubergines, and fragrant sweet basil. Large 4-litre tub.
ingredients: Halal Chicken Breast, Coconut Milk, Green Curry Paste (Green Chili, Lemongrass, Garlic, Galangal, Kaffir Lime, Shrimp Paste), Thai Aubergines, Pea Aubergines, Sweet Basil, Red Chili, Fish Sauce, Palm Sugar.

name: Red Chicken Curry with Bamboo (4000ml)
nameTh: แกงเผ็ดไก่หน่อไม้
desc: Traditional red curry with tender chicken, crisp bamboo shoots, and Thai sweet basil in rich coconut gravy. Large 4-litre tub.
ingredients: Halal Chicken Breast, Coconut Milk, Red Curry Paste, Bamboo Shoots, Thai Aubergines, Sweet Basil, Red Chili, Fish Sauce, Palm Sugar.

name: Chicken Satay Skewers (Tray - 30 Pcs)
nameTh: ไก่สะเต๊ะ 30 ไม้ + ซอสถั่ว & อาจาด
desc: Tender chicken breast skewers marinated with turmeric and lemongrass, charcoal-grilled. Served with authentic rich peanut sauce and cucumber relish.
ingredients: Halal Chicken Breast, Turmeric, Curry Powder, Coconut Milk, Lemongrass, Garlic. Peanut Sauce: Ground Roasted Peanuts, Coconut Milk, Red Curry Paste, Tamarind, Palm Sugar, Fish Sauce. Ajad: Cucumber, Shallots, Red Chili, Vinegar, Sugar.

name: Vegetable Spring Rolls (Tray - 30 Pcs)
nameTh: ปอเปี๊ยะทอดผักรวม 30 ชิ้น
desc: Crispy golden pastry rolls filled with shredded cabbage, carrots, wood ear mushrooms, and glass noodles. Served with sweet plum sauce.
ingredients: Wheat Spring Roll Pastry, Cabbage, Carrots, Glass Noodles, Wood Ear Mushrooms, White Pepper, Soy Sauce, Sesame Oil, Vegetable Oil. Dip: Sweet Plum Sauce.

name: Pad Thai Chicken (Large Tray)
nameTh: ผัดไทยไก่เส้นจันท์ถาดใหญ่
desc: Stir-fried Thai rice noodles with chicken, eggs, yellow tofu, bean sprouts, and garlic chives in tamarind sauce. Served with crushed peanuts and lime wedges.
ingredients: Rice Noodles, Halal Chicken, Free-Range Eggs, Firm Yellow Tofu, Sweet Radish, Bean Sprouts, Garlic Chives, Tamarind Paste, Palm Sugar, Fish Sauce, Crushed Peanuts, Lime.

name: Som Tam Thai - Green Papaya Salad (Tray)
nameTh: ส้มตำไทยถาดใหญ่
desc: Crisp green papaya pounded with long beans, cherry tomatoes, garlic, chili, roasted peanuts, and dried shrimp in tangy palm sugar lime dressing.
ingredients: Green Papaya, Carrots, Long Green Beans, Cherry Tomatoes, Garlic, Bird's Eye Chili, Roasted Peanuts, Dried Shrimp, Fish Sauce, Lime Juice, Tamarind Pulp, Palm Sugar.

name: Steamed Thai Jasmine Rice (Extra Large Tray)
nameTh: ข้าวหอมมะลิแท้ถาดใหญ่พิเศษ
desc: Steamed 100% authentic Thai Hom Mali fragrant jasmine rice, soft, fluffy, and naturally aromatic.
ingredients: 100% Pure Thai Hom Mali Jasmine Rice, Water.

name: Mango Sticky Rice Platter (Party Tray)
nameTh: ข้าวเหนียวมะม่วงถาดปาร์ตี้
desc: Sweet fragrant glutinous sticky rice infused with coconut milk, served with sweet sliced Thai honey mangoes and rich salted coconut sauce.
ingredients: Thai Sweet Glutinous Rice, Ripe Thai Honey Mangoes, Coconut Milk, Sugar, Salt, Toasted Crispy Mung Beans / Toasted Sesame.
